# Error message missing details in translation blocks

## Description

I found an issue with the error messages when using translation blocks. When using invalid control structures inside a translation block, the error message is missing important details.

For example, when I try to use an invalid control structure inside a translation block:

```jinja2
{% trans %}foo{% wibble bar %}{% endwibble %}{% endtrans %}
```

The error message only says:
```
control structures in translatable sections are not allowed
```

But it doesn't tell me which control structure was found. Previously, it would show the name of the control structure that was causing the problem.

Also, when trying to nest translation blocks:

```jinja2
{% trans %}foo{% trans %}{% endtrans %}
```

I don't get a specific error message explaining that trans blocks can't be nested. Instead, I just get the generic error about control structures not being allowed.

This makes debugging templates more difficult since the error messages are less specific than they used to be.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and submit the resulting local patch: src/jinja2/ext.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
